dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent closed loops ('O' shapes) show irregular, jittery outer perimeters with sharp contrast transitions from a dark-grey exterior to a light-grey interior. The most distinct structures are concentrated along the dorsal ridge and the upper lateral midsection.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-intensity white or light-grey pixel clusters (speckles) concentrated primarily on the lower lateral flank and towards the posterior-dorsal transition, lacking the internal gradient of the larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest side extending towards the posterior-lateral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A single, high-contrast linear filament or 'bridge' of light-colored pixels connects two macro-annuli near the dorsal-central apex.
